messages:
alyssa: Heads-up — saw a customer report where a streaming request that triggered a tool call ended up billed twice after a reconnect during our canary. trace id: rt-9f3a

kira: ugh. is this the reconnect that retried the toolcall or the streaming chunk? :eyes:

alyssa: reconnect retried the stream, router fell back to cheaper region, runtime retried the toolcall (idempotency token missing), end result: provisional credits for initial stream + confirmed credits after toolcall replay. logs snippet:```
[rt-9f3a] route=canary->region-b fallback=true
[rt-9f3a] runtime: toolcall_id=null -> calling tool at 2025-11-07T14:12:03Z
[rt-9f3a] billing: provisional:+120 tokens
[rt-9f3a] runtime: toolcall completed, tokens=95
[rt-9f3a] billing: confirmed:+95 tokens (no dedupe)
```

matt: do we have a dedupe key for toolcalls? I thought the client sends an idempotency key.

alyssa: client did for the toolcall, but our router dropped it on the swap (internal header rewrite). router->runtime header mapping bug.

sara: so two problems: header preservation on route swap + billing dedupe not using the canonical session id. agree?

josh: correct. billing only dedupes on billing.request_id which is produced by the runtime after the toolcall completes. we never write provisional credits with an opaque canonical id that survives a route change.

kira: proposal: attach X-Session-Commit-ID at router start and propagate to billing for provisional credits. runtime can later update confirmed credits referencing the same commit id. then billing can reconcile without double counting.

matt: +1 but edge: what about tokenization differences between fallback models? if we route to a smaller model mid-request tokens can differ (eg. 120 provisional vs 95 confirmed). billing should prefer confirmed but only subtract provisional once. need clear semantics.

alyssa: yes — idea: provisional = optimistic upstream estimate (router uses model_profile.estimate_tokens()). confirmed = runtime.count_tokens(actual_stream). billing reconcile: charge = max(confirmed, min(provisional, confirmed + safety_window)) ? that's messy.

sara: we should avoid heuristics in billing. simpler: billing records provisional as "tentative" not yet charged to invoice. when confirmed arrives, billing replaces tentative with confirmed. if confirmed never arrives (time-out), we expire tentative and surface a refund/adjustment flow in console.

kira: that requires console UX: mark provisional credits in red with a tooltip "tentative, may be adjusted" and a retention TTL visible. paging ops if large.

matt: telemetry: add events: billing.provisional.created (session_commit_id, estimate, model_hint), billing.confirmed.set (session_commit_id, final_tokens). make these joinable in our observability pipeline.

josh: internal API debate: should router be responsible for emitting session_commit_id or runtime? router is the only component that can guarantee stability across reroutes. runtime would need to accept a header. downside: router becomes coupled to billing model.

alyssa: I'd prefer router emits X-Session-Commit-ID and runtime accepts it, but keep the header optional. if missing, runtime will synthesize and billing will mark as runtime-scoped.

devops-bot: deploy queued: canary-patch/router-preserve-headers -> will run at 03:00 UTC if approved. :rocket:

kira: ok owners: @alyssa owns billing reconciliation design doc, @matt will prototype console UI for provisional vs confirmed, @sara will PR header propagation in router, @josh will add telemetry hooks.

alyssa: immediate short-term mitigation: revert canary routing that rewrites headers (rolled back earlier but partially re-enabled). also add a temporary guard in runtime to reject toolcall replay without idempotency header.

matt: I'll add a dashboard tile: "provisional credits vs confirmed delta" and an alert if delta > 5% across 5m window so ops can triage.

sara: leaving a note: when we roll out change, ensure quota checks still happen on provisional stage (so quota gating prevents spikes) but final enforcement happens on confirmed — need to sync with quota team.

alyssa: agreed. filing follow-ups: GH issues -> billing#412 (reconcile flow), console#221 (ux tile), router#78 (header propagation), telemetry#99 (events).

kira: thanks all. ping when deploy scheduled. :thumbsup:
